title: feat: add a javascript tool to Computer MCP
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Computer MCP adds a `javascript` tool alongside `bash`. It runs an ES module’s default-exported function in a fresh Dynamic Worker and returns stdout, stderr and the JSON-encoded return value; thrown errors are reported as tool errors. JavaScript can read and write the same persistent files as `bash` through `node:fs/promises`, import the user’s own modules relative to `cwd`, and fetch public URLs through the same Egress gateway as curl. `/tmp` is cleared after each call. npm packages are unavailable, and I/O must happen inside the exported function rather than during module loading. The Computer MCP documentation and Gen catalog description now include JavaScript.
